title: Native adic comparison records
statement: For a prime ℓ and scheme X, the normalized section comparison record consists of the actual coefficient functions, an equivalence of native internal modules with sectionwise module sheaves, and the unit, tensor, slice-Hom, evaluation, bidual and finite coordinate comparisons, pinned by their formulas on sections. The local tensor, evaluation, pullback and dual pullback maps are the specified composites of the native maps. This record is exactly AdicModuleSectionComparison from lem-sf-adic-module-slice-hom-comparison, without changing any field.

proof.text: Unchanged records and canonical composite maps from the original comparison statement.

proof_origin.place: Native/sectionwise module comparison, Stacks 03CV, 03EK, 03EO and 0E8H; formal assembly follows the section normalizations.
